'''Sean Schemmel''' is an American voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Schemmel was born on November 21, 1968, in Waterloo, Iowa. His father left his mother while she was still pregnant with him, leaving Schemmel to be raised by a stepfather.<ref>''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BmMmvieMEjc SEAN SCHEMMEL INTERVIEW PART 1 OF 2: Becoming Goku, Music, Puppets, Life.]''</ref> He attended and graduated from North Texas State University, after which he pursued a voice acting career. Schemmel first joined the series during [[S06|the sixth season]]. As with most other voice actors who worked with [[4Kids Entertainment]], he left when {{TPCi|Pokémon USA}} and [[TAJ Productions]] [[Pokémon USA recasting controversy|took over the dubbing and distribution of the series]]. As of ''[[DP058|Nosing 'Round the Mountain!]]'', Schemmel has returned to provide voices for many more characters.

Schemmel had moved to Los Angeles at some point during the {{aniseries|XY|XY series}}, and after a long absence, returned to {{aniseries|PTS}} once more in ''[[S23|Pokemon Journeys: The Series]]'', starting with ''[[JN014|Raid Battle in the Ruins!]]'', in which he has always been uncredited as providing his voice role as Ash's Dracovish. Schemmel returned to being credited during {{aniseries|HZ}}. Schemmel is currently affiliated with Arlene Thornton & Associates.
